name: BWX Technologies, Inc.
blurb: BWX Technologies is a U.S.-based manufacturer of nuclear components, reactors, and nuclear fuel serving government and commercial customers in the United States, Canada, and internationally. The company operates through two segments — Government Operations and Commercial Operations — producing precision naval nuclear components, reactor systems, critical nuclear assemblies, and uranium downblending services. Founded in 1867 and employing roughly 10,400 people, BWXT is a primary supplier to the U.S. Navy's nuclear propulsion program and is positioned at the intersection of defense and the civilian nuclear renaissance. With a market cap near $19 billion and trailing revenue of $3.4 billion, it is one of the few vertically integrated nuclear technology contractors in North America.
recent: BWXT reported Q1 2026 earnings on May 4, 2026, with trailing twelve-month EPS of $3.75 (+19.4% year-over-year) and net income of $344.6 million (+19.2%), reflecting strong government demand. The stock closed at $206.83 on May 13, 2026, sitting in the upper half of its 52-week range of $106.22–$241.82; market cap has expanded roughly 91% over the trailing year, driven by renewed U.S. nuclear-defense spending and advanced reactor interest. An upcoming ex-dividend date of May 19, 2026 ($1.08 annual dividend) and a consensus analyst Buy rating with a $209.96 price target round out the near-term picture.
